products.title: Getting To The 10th Planet by Zach Maslany
products.body:
Learn to Navigate Your Way Into Essential 10th Planet Systems and Give Your overall BJJ Game a Unique Upgrade Featuring Eddie Bravo Black Belt Zach Maslany
  • Zach Maslany is a Black Belt under the legendary Eddie Bravo, co-founder of 10th Planet Bethlehem in Pennsylvania, and co-founder of Finishers Only Grappling Tournament
  • Get an introduction to 4 of 10th Planet’s most essential attacking platforms, the truck, rubber guard, spider web, and the lockdown all with step by step guidance from a respected 10th Planet Black Belt helping you through the process
  • If you're new to the 10th Planet systems, Maslany will help you gain a greater understanding of those 10P terms you hear around the gym but have never had the opportunity to try
  • Utilize these specific 10P positions to add completely different dimensions to your game
  • Transition from positions you already know like mount and the x guard seamlessly into the truck, rubber guard, lockdown, and spiderweb as you learn the subsequent attacks and utilities of these dynamic 10P systems

products.title: Warming Up The 10th Planet Way by Zach Maslany and Jon Blank
products.body:
Zach Maslany & Jon Black of 10th-Planet Bethlehem Teach The Method Behind Their Madness With Their Warm Ups That Students Can Use To Flow, Warm Up, & Improve Quicker
  • Learn how to combine body movements, technique drilling, and flowing through common situations to create the best possible warm up to improve with
  • Zack Maslany and Jon Blank are 10th-Planet Bethlehem black belt instructors who are joining up to show you how they have created a system for the best use of warm up time
  • Zack and Jon’s method involves 8 different warmup programs that they use on a rotating basis, each one built and designed to bring out one aspect of your game
  • Use granby rolls, inversions, guard passes, half guard, X guard, and more together for easy and fun ways to get your body moving
  • Get direct instruction on how each warm up is best done, what you are improving, and examples of these done at full speed

products.title: The 10th Planet Half Guard by Zach Maslany
products.body:
10th-Planet Bethlehem Grappling Coach Zack Maislany Teaches You The Unorthodox Half Guard System That He & His Students Use To Beat Opponents - Even Ones Bigger & Stronger
  • Use high-percentage offense that 10th-Planet is known for, including the lockdown, electric chair, the stomp, and more
  • Zack Maislany is an experienced 10th-Planet black belt who runs the Bethlehem Academy that has helped produce elite competition grappling talent
  • Recover half guard with unusual but effective techniques for absorbing pressure, keeping good position, and getting back on offense
  • Find opportunities to attack with octopus guard, as you see how this half guard series can help you take the back, sweep to top, and more
  • Find submission threats, including a full breakdown on how to set up the buggy choke and get the tap against talented opposition

products.title: Wrestling For Jiu Jitsu by Zach Maslany
products.body:
Most grapplers lose the match before it starts, standing there with no idea how to get the fight to the ground, and Zach Maslany built this course for exactly that problem.

  • Zach Maslany is a 10th Planet black belt under Eddie Bravo and a co-founder of 10th Planet Bethlehem, known for building competitors out of ordinary training partners.
  • In Wrestling For Jiu Jitsu, Maslany covers the takedowns that actually fit jiu jitsu: the throw by, foot sweeps, the single and the double, the ankle pick, the over hook and underhook game, and the front headlock with its submissions.
  • This isn't just a takedown course, it's wrestling filtered through what a grappler is allowed to do and what happens after the takedown.


What Will You Learn?

Most grapplers lose the match before it starts, standing there with no idea how to get the fight to the ground, and Zach Maslany built this course for exactly that problem.

Maslany is a black belt under Eddie Bravo and co-founded 10th Planet Bethlehem, where he has spent years turning hobbyists into competitors. He teaches wrestling the way a jiu jitsu coach has to teach it, for people who will never have a college wrestling room behind them. Now he's putting that curriculum in one place.

Volume one is the offense: the path to the back, the throw by and slide by, foot sweeps, the single leg, the double leg and the crackdown, the ankle pick into arm bars, the over hook and underhook, and the front headlock with its submissions. Volume two is the fight before the takedown, handfighting, counters, live drills and the wrestle up from seated guard. Volume three connects it back to the ground: guillotines, back takes, granby rolls, octopus guard, half guard, X guard, butterfly and the truck. This isn't just a takedown course, it's wrestling filtered through what a grappler is allowed to do and what happens after the takedown.

Whether you compete or just want to stop pulling guard out of habit, the standing position stops being the part of the round you survive.

The live drills are the part people skip and the part that makes it stick. Maslany builds the constraint games that let you train handfighting and takedown entries without a wrestling team and without getting hurt.

If you've ever wondered why wrestlers control where a match happens while everyone else reacts, this is the material that closes that gap.

Learn how to take the fight to the ground and keep the advantage once you get there.

What Exactly Do You Get?

Part 1: Takedowns And The Front Headlock

  • Intro Wrestle Jitsu - Path To The Back
  • Throw By - Slide By
  • Foot Sweeps - Merkle
  • Single Leg
  • Double Leg - Crackdown
  • Ankle Pick - Arm Bars
  • Over Hook - Underhook Intro
  • Over Hook - Underhook Going Deeper
  • The Most Used Position (Front Headlock)
  • Front Headlock Submissions
  • Triangles - Win Dixie

Part 2: Handfighting, Counters And Live Drills

  • Front Headlock Counters
  • Full Speed Takedowns - Counters
  • Handfighting
  • More Handfighting
  • Live Drills - CLA Game
  • Live Drills - CLA Game 2
  • Seated Guard Wrestle Up
  • Drag Out
  • Guillotines
  • Gator Rolls

Part 3: Connecting Wrestling To The Ground

  • Arm In Guillotine - Butterfly Sweeps
  • Back Take - Guillotine
  • Underhook Front Head Lock
  • Granby Rolls
  • Octopus Guard
  • Half Guard
  • X Guard
  • Butterfly Guard
  • The Truck
